title: The Project page projects
text: Run the projection service on your own machine and the Project page sends it your matrix. It shows every cell's label or abstention with its reason, and you can download the full response.

title: The model card compares like with like
text: Every accuracy on the Versions page now names the decision rule it was scored with, and comes from the committed tables. One comparison had set a seed under one rule against a mean under another; it now pairs them under the same rule.

title: v3.1 is in progress
text: Label space estimation, a defined abstention rule and conformal calibration are being built and tested in notebooks T1 NB2 to NB4. Nothing reaches the atlas or the service until each one passes its go or no-go.

title: One design across the site
text: Every page now shares one look, and this dashboard is the way in to each tool.

title: The atlas runs on the v3 reference
text: The atlas viewer shows cells placed by the frozen, RNA-only v3 reference. Protein cells are placed zero-shot: no protein labels were used in training.
